meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令管理视频项目:初始化、lint/check 检查、preview 预览、render 渲染,支持本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda 和 Google Cloud Run 渲染,并在你批准后才输出最终视频。
howto.when: 当你说要创建或修改 HyperFrames 视频项目、诊断构建或渲染失败,或要求预览、对比、发布等开发循环操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 运行 npx hyperframes init 搭建项目。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes check 并给我预览链接
say.note: 先检查再打开 Studio 预览,等你确认。

say.text: 用草稿画质渲染 out.mp4 并验证文件
say.note: 生成草稿视频并检查文件存在、时长合理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages video projects via npx hyperframes: init, lint/check, preview, render, supporting local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run; final rendering waits for your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or modify a HyperFrames video project, diagnose build/render failures, or run dev-loop actions like preview, compare, or publish.

say_en.text: Initialize a new HyperFrames video project for me.
say_en.note: Runs npx hyperframes init to scaffold it.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check and give me the preview link.
say_en.note: Checks first, opens Studio preview, waits for your confirmation.

say_en.text: Render out.mp4 at draft quality and verify the file.
say_en.note: Produces a draft video and checks file existence and duration.
